subject: White‑label SDK / reseller onboarding — next steps and tech questions
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: White‑label SDK trial + reseller onboarding proposal

Hi Samir / Elena —

Great to meet both of you last week. As discussed, attaching a first pass at the white‑label SDK bundle (v1.2) and a draft reseller SLA so your product team can evaluate integration effort and expected performance. High level proposal:

- Redwood provides a white‑label SDK that surfaces a slim API for inference + embedding calls and a branding layer your UI can control.
- BrightPath licenses the SDK under a reseller MOU; Redwood hosts the inference endpoint while BrightPath controls customer billing and UX.
- Two‑month pilot (50k tokens/day cap) -> scale into Dedicated pools after pilot if throughput looks good.

Attachments: WhiteLabel_SDK_v1.2.zip (SDK + example app), Reseller_SLAs_draft_20260315.pdf, MOU_BrightPath-Redwood_20260310.docx

Open questions we need to confirm before the technical deep dive:
1) Branding: how strict is the white‑label requirement? (full removal of Redwood logos vs co‑branded)
2) Data flow: will BrightPath route customer traffic through your own gateway or directly to Redwood?
3) Security: SSO / SCIM for partner engineers, and whether you need customer‑managed KMS for keys.

Can we schedule a technical deep dive on Thursday (Mar 18) afternoon PT? Rafael — looping you in for onboarding ops.

Thanks,

— Soojin Lee
Senior Partner Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

From: Samir Shah <samir@brightpath.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Elena Costa <ecosta@reselltech.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: White‑label SDK trial + reseller onboarding proposal

Thanks Soojin — this looks promising. A few clarifying items from BrightPath engineering / product before we lock the deep dive: 

- Branding: BrightPath needs the customer UX to show only BrightPath marks for end users. We can accept co‑branding in admin consoles but must hide Redwood branding in the product UI. Is that supported in v1.2?
- Telemetry: our security team wants to know what telemetry the SDK ships back to Redwood (usage metrics, error traces). Can you share a short list?
- KMS/keys: some of our enterprise customers require customer‑managed keys (Azure Key Vault / AWS KMS). Can we integrate with Bring‑Your‑Own‑KMS?
- SLA / refunds: the reseller SLA doc looks fine, but we need a clause about incident credit pass‑through to the end customer.

Also cc'ing BrightPath legal at legal@brightpath.ai for the MOU read. Confirming Thursday 18th works for a tech deep dive — morning PT is better for our team if possible.

— Samir
CTO, BrightPath Analytics
samir@brightpath.ai

Subject: Re: Fwd: White‑label SDK trial + reseller onboarding proposal — BrightPath questions

Thanks Soojin — quick legal view ahead of the external call. High‑level comments on the MOU + SLA: 

- White‑label: we can permit removal of public‑facing Redwood marks; however, we need to preserve a small legal attribution in the Terms of Service between BrightPath and their customers (e.g., "inference provided by Redwood Inference, Inc."). We'll propose language that sits in the back‑end TOS rather than the visible UI.
- Telemetry/Data: require explicit enumeration of telemetry categories and an opt‑out for any PII collection. We must also include a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) and standard audit rights for SOC2 evidence upon 30 days notice.
- BYOK: acceptable in principle; need product to confirm whether key material ever traverses Redwood control plane. If keys remain customer‑side and tokens are encrypted in transit, we can support.
- Incident credits: legal is fine with a pass‑through clause provided there is a clear service mapping and incident attribution process in the SLA.

I will prepare a redline of the MOU and the SLA today and share before the tech call. Rafael / Mateo please confirm the BYOK flow and any limitations ASAP.

— Neha Kapoor
Head of Legal (Commercial)
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
